entities.summary: Mikhail Alexandrovich Maslin was a Russian historian of philosophy and Distinguished Professor at the Lomonosov Moscow State University (2001), where he held the chair of Russian Philosophy. He was a member of the Russian Philosophical Society since 1973 and served on the editorial boards of Philosophy of Economy, Philosophy and Education, and Philosophy and Society. Prof. Maslin published over 80 scientific works, including a number of monographs and textbooks. Maslin died on 20 June 2025, at the age of 77.
